description: Hosts an image, video or audio file on Relay and returns its url: pass that url to any *_url input of run_model. Give exactly one of path (local server only, ≤ 100 MB), base64 (≤ 4 MB) or url (a public link Relay copies). retention: relay1h (default, free within a daily quota) or a media_storage SKU from get_pricing. Needs a Relay credential.

base64.description: File content as base64 or a data: URI, at most 4 MB decoded. Larger files: pass url.

filename.description: File name to record (defaults to the path's base name).

path.description: Local file path (stdio server only; the hosted server cannot read your disk). Max 100 MB.

retention.description: How long the link lives: relay1h (default, free within a daily quota) or a media_storage SKU from get_pricing (relay1d, relay7d, …).

slot.description: true: get a single-use upload URL (10 minutes): run the curl line in your shell on the local file, or open open_url in a browser and pick the file; either prints the hosted link.

url.description: Public http(s) link to copy onto Relay.

name: upload_file
title: Upload a file to Relay
